description: An sk- key whose ASCII-alphanumeric run reaches the capture cut (CAPTURE_CHARS, 17408 characters) is redacted whatever its length, since it may go on past the cut; a giant Bearer token before it keeps the line short enough to show it. msg: three characters left; one and nine: one and nine left. As ever: empty, the cut falls right after sk- and no character is left; glued, xsk- has no boundary before it; ended, the run after sk- ends before the cut and the run that reaches it is no key; exact, the value is exactly 17408 characters, so nothing was cut and its five-character key stays (docs/contract.md, Values: the capture limit).

lines: level=INFO logger=teleclaude.core msg="Bearer <REDACTED> sk-<REDACTED>" empty="Bearer <REDACTED> sk-" ended="Bearer <REDACTED> sk-abc.d" exact="Bearer <REDACTED> sk-abcde" glued="Bearer <REDACTED> xsk-abcde" nine="Bearer <REDACTED> sk-<REDACTED>" one="Bearer <REDACTED> sk-<REDACTED>"
